panels.title: feat(web): support page at /support (App Store review requires a real support URL)
panels.scene: Knight casually hammers a tiny wooden sign labeled '/support' into the mud outside the castle. A giant golden Apple Emperor in the sky nods approvingly. Villagers are weeping on their knees in front of the tiny sign, lighting candles.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A holy shrine where our crying may finally be heard!

bubbles.speaker: Other Villager
bubbles.text: I shall bring my sick goat to /support!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It is a blank page so Apple lets us open the shop.

panels.title: fix(payment): never report a purchase as processed when it was not recorded
panels.scene: A glowing ghost merchant hands a villager an invisible sword while shouting 'PURCHASE COMPLETE!' Knight slaps the ghost with a heavy leather ledger book, trapping it inside.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: He slayed the lying demon! No more ghost receipts!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: If it is not written in the book, you did not buy it.

panels.title: fix(iap): a refund restores what actually left the balance, not what Apple revoked
panels.scene: A giant Apple Monster snatches a tiny coin from a villager, but a magic treasure chest explodes and dumps 10,000 gold coins onto the villager. Knight calmly fixes a tiny balance scale on top of the chest.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The cosmic math is healed! The chest knows true justice!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Apple took ten coins, but your account only had one.

panels.title: 9 commits. 8 fixes. 1 feature. 1 giant apple satisfied.
panels.scene: Knight sitting slumped on a wooden bench, exhausted. In the background, villagers are carving a giant stone statue of a knight holding a giant apple and a receipt scroll.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our newborn baby Atomic-Refund!
